name: Collection Manager
overview: Visual metadata-driven native collection creation for Jellyfin.
description: Private-testing build for Jellyfin 10.11.11. Creates ordinary Jellyfin collections from existing tags, providers, networks, genres, people, studios, years, local NFO fields, and other scanned metadata.

versions.changelog: Restores original artwork preview sizes; fixes successful image saves, authenticated font and logo assets, logo-draft previews, and requested metadata source grouping and spaced labels.
